taiga.on_project_event.description: 当 Taiga 项目发生选定的 Webhook 事件时触发。

configInputs.projectId: Numeric Taiga project ID to monitor.
configInputs.types: Optional Taiga entity types to filter.
configInputs.actions: Webhook action types to subscribe to.

outputs.deliveryId: Unique delivery ID for this event.
outputs.body: Original webhook or polled event payload.
